title: Erste Liga Round 5 of Finals. Buducnost top Mornar to capture the trophy
description: Buducnost - Mornar 90-82 Buducnost became the Erste League champions. They prevailed against Mornar in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the 14th League title. Buducnost made 25-of-32 free shots (78.1 percent) during the game. 28 personal fouls committed by Mornar helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American point guard Kendrick Perry (183-1992, college: YSU) orchestrated the victory by scoring 27 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists. The former international center Zoran Nikolic (212-1996, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 9 points and 7 rebounds for the winners. Buducnost's coach Aleksandar Dzikic used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
